named_subject: a cat's head (cat face with pointed ears, two eyes and whiskers)
action: The cat head stays tilted up and to the left with only small shifts through frames 1-6, then drops lower and moves right, turning more upright, in frames 7-8.
identity_gap: The head outline, eye shapes, ear construction and whisker strokes match the doodle closely; the drawing is only rotated and moved. In frames 5-6 the ears are cut off at the top edge of the frame, and the head never turns into profile the way the doodle's construction would need to.
notes: Frames 1-6 match the film's upward-tilted head, and frames 7-8 match its lower, right-shifted position, but the film shows the cat turning to a right-facing profile while the drawing stays front-facing and only slides and rotates, so the change between frames 6 and 7 reads as a jump. The change that would help most is to turn the head toward profile across frames 7-8 (shift the eyes and nose to the right and narrow the far side of the face) and add an in-between so the move is not a single pop.
